Done. Summary of actions taken for the UK March 2026 close:

1. **Management fee (US → UK), JE-00305** — Booked UK's side of ICI-2026-03-UK: Dr 6550 Intercompany Management Fees / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable, GBP 12,000.00 (USD 15,000.00 ÷ 1.2500 March policy rate). Supported by DOC-0206 + DOC-0201. Since the USD-equivalent value (15,000) exceeds the USD 10,000 senior-accountant threshold, I submitted a `request_approval` — entry is posted but pending controller sign-off.

2. **Intercompany loan remeasurement, JE-00306** — Verified opening balance on 2400 (GBP 157,480.31, matching the 1.2700 drawdown rate per DOC-0016), then remeasured the USD 200,000 loan at the March policy rate of 1.2500 → GBP 160,000.00. Booked the GBP 2,519.69 FX loss: Dr 6950 FX Gain/Loss / Cr 2400 Intercompany Loan Payable. Supported by DOC-0016 + DOC-0201. This is under the approval threshold, no further action needed.

No unsupportable items were encountered, so nothing was flagged as an exception. Checklist item "Intercompany reconciliation" (UK) set to in_progress pending controller approval of JE-00305. Memo submitted to the controller.
